findings.claim: the sandbox shipped to treatment arms carries a selftest battery that omits task-coverage --self-test while its own comment explains the decisions-register dependency was added precisely so the battery could include it — the sandboxes run a lying battery, the same silent-skip class issue #16 killed in the home repo
findings.proof: build a treatment sandbox and run npm run selftest: task-coverage is never exercised, yet the AGENTS stanza tells the agent 'Verify with npm run selftest' — verification that skips the fence tool certifies nothing about it

findings.claim: the killed-run refusal has a live probe (hanging module, ungradable JSON, exit 1) but no battery pin — runSuite's timeout is hardcoded 60s and a battery case would pay it on every run
findings.evidence: tools/bench/grade.mjs runSuite; wave transcript probe output
findings.dedupKey: tools/bench/grade.mjs runsuite; wave transcript probe output
findings.justification: runSuite's 60s timeout is hardcoded and a battery case would pay it on every battery run forever; the live probe (hanging module, ungradable:true, exit 1) is recorded in this register's wave and the refusal is three lines feeding a shared exit law
